cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
Chrome 一个讲 2019 年 JS 的仓库
单日涨了 2,106 颗星
cover.dek: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance 此前每天只有约 10 颗星，前天 903，昨天 1,925，今天 2,106。它在 Hacker News 拿到 434 分，做的事是让 Agent 别再写旧版 JS。
cover.title_en:
A Chrome repo about modern JS
gained 2,106 stars in a day
cover.dek_en: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance was getting about 10 stars a day. It hit 903, then 1,925, then 2,106 today, and scored 434 on Hacker News. Its pitch is simple: stop agents from writing 2019-era JS.

stickers.title: 论文主线
stickers.text: WikiTrace 把每条经验链接回原始轨迹，减少记忆拖累任务的退化，HF 👍60。
stickers.text_en: WikiTrace links each memory back to its original trajectory to curb memory-induced regressions. 60 HF upvotes.

stickers.title: 航司禁令
stickers.text: United Airlines 禁止 AI agent 代订机票，HN 636 分、661 评论，超过所有项目帖。
stickers.text_en: United Airlines bars AI agents from booking flights. 636 points and 661 comments on HN, more than any project post.

stickers.title: 并行控制台
stickers.text: t3code 日增 +1,354，已连续 41 天；orca 日增 +1,077，连续 142 天。
stickers.text_en: t3code added 1,354 stars, its 41st day of growth in a row. orca added 1,077, now at 142 days.
